Trump approval rating now\",\"url\":\"https://yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/donald-trumps-approval-rating-today-095555939.html\"},{\"title\":\"Opinion polling on the second Trump presidency\",\"url\":\"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opinion_polling_on_the_second_Trump_presidency\"},{\"title\":\"Donald Trump's approval rating as of today;
